correctness.rationale: Crown adjacency is [[0,J-I],[J-I,0]]. Because 2 is invertible in characteristic 3, change to sum/difference shores gives B=J-I and -B, and J^2=nJ. For n divisible by 3, J has a nontrivial rank-one nilpotent J2; the corresponding ±1 adjacency blocks lift to J4 at the temporal eigenvalue ±1, accompanied by J2 pairs. For n=1 mod3, the constant lines have spatial eigenvalue zero and produce two irreducible quadratic X^2+1 blocks of order 4. For n=2 mod3 all temporal pieces are J2(±1). Taking fixed dimensions min(size,3^v3(t)), conditioned on parity and divisibility by four, gives each of the three source formulas and exact minimal orders; invertibility provides immediate periodicity and Mobius populations. Independently built matrices and checked every time through the asserted order over F3 for n=5,...,9. All n and field extensions follow from the algebraic decomposition, not finite testing.
